properties.name: security.jwt.secret
properties.description: HMAC secret used by auth-service to sign JWT tokens.

properties.name: security.jwt.issuer
properties.description: Issuer claim included in JWT tokens emitted by auth-service.

properties.name: auth.bootstrap-admin.enabled
properties.description: Enables one-time creation of the initial ADMIN user during startup.

properties.name: auth.bootstrap-admin.email
properties.description: Email used for the initial ADMIN user when bootstrap is enabled.

properties.name: auth.bootstrap-admin.password
properties.description: Password used for the initial ADMIN user when bootstrap is enabled.
